review_policy.label_error_meaning: The scoped present/not_observed assessment is not supported by the supplied pseudo-C.
review_policy.evidence_error_meaning: The target finding does not expose the target-CWE relation needed to teach or justify the assessment.

decisions.notes: CWE-400 not_observed target cites only result messages and omits the visible 1..2000 range guard that makes the sleep duration bounded.
CWE-401 not_observed target cites allocation and stack-canary checks but omits the visible free(pvVar1) operations that establish resource release.
CWE-23 present target cites only buffer zero-initialization; it omits the untrusted fgets append followed by open(dataBuffer), which is the path-traversal relation.
CWE-23 not_observed target again cites only buffer zero-initialization; it omits the fixed file.txt append and subsequent open operation.
CWE-195 not_observed target cites allocation and memory writes but omits the visible data = 99 assignment that removes the negative-size conversion relation.
CWE-134 not_observed target mixes safe %s calls with variable-format calls but omits the fixed-string source assignment needed to justify why the latter is scoped as not observed.
